question: The colour of CuCl₂ solution is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**blue-green.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Copper (II) chloride** (CuCl₂) is a compound that is **greenish-brown **in solid form.
 
• However, when it is dissolved in water, it forms a** blue-green **solution.
 
• The blue-green colour of the solution is due to the presence of** Cu2+ ions**, which absorb light in the** orange and red regions** of the spectrum and appear blue-green to the human eye.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Copper (II) chloride** is commonly used as a reagent in chemistry experiments and is also used in the production of** pigments, dyes, and wood preservatives.**
 
• **Copper (I) chloride** can produce a **red or green **colour in solution depending on the concentration and conditions.
 
• **Cobalt (II) chloride** produces a **pink/red** colour in solution.
 
• **Nickel (II) chloride** produces a **yellow-green** colour in solution.
